ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
tl: Allazi at'amahum min ju'inw-wa-aamana hum min khawf
en: Their security during winter and summer journeys.
Let them worship the Lord of this House.
Who has fed them against hunger, and has secured them against fear.
sw: Kuzoea kwao safari za siku za baridi na siku za joto.
Basi nawamuabudu Mola Mlezi wa Nyumba hii,
Ambaye anawalisha wasipate njaa, na anawalinda na khofu.
fr: A cause du pacte des Coraïch,
De leur pacte [concernant] les voyages d'hiver et d'été.
Qu'ils adorent donc le Seigneur de cette Maison [la Ka'ba],
qui les a nourris contre la faim et rassurés de la crainte!
